number.description: MSISDN in E.164 format to query.

features.description: Contains requested features. Fallback to LineType if not provided.

rndFeatureOptions.description: Required when RND feature is requested.

x-enumDescriptions.LineType: Use to return line type information for the phone number.
x-enumDescriptions.SimSwap: Use to determine whether the phone number is SIM swapped.
x-enumDescriptions.VoIPDetection: Use to determine if the carrier is associated with a VoIP provider (alpha).
x-enumDescriptions.RND: Use to determine whether the phone number has been disconnected (alpha).

contactDate.description: Last contact date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
